description: A utility module for generating HTML diffs between two multi-line strings, primarily used for visualizing differences between text files in testing or comparison scenarios.

classes.name: HtmlDiffGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating HTML representations of diffs between two lists of lines.

methods.name: html_diff
methods.description: Main function that returns an HTML diff between two strings.

methods.name: HtmlDiffGenerator.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing line counters for diff generation.

methods.name: HtmlDiffGenerator.generate_tbody
methods.description: Generates the HTML table body representing the diff between two line lists.

methods.name: HtmlDiffGenerator._format_chunk
methods.description: Formats a diff chunk based on its tag (equal, insert, delete, replace).

methods.name: HtmlDiffGenerator._format_equal
methods.description: Formats a chunk of lines that are equal in both texts.

methods.name: HtmlDiffGenerator._format_equal_line
methods.description: Formats a single line of equal content with line numbers.

methods.name: HtmlDiffGenerator._format_insert
methods.description: Formats inserted lines in the diff.

methods.name: HtmlDiffGenerator._format_delete
methods.description: Formats deleted lines in the diff.
